# Generated by the harness from the recorded calls. Edit the body in place.
from typing import Any, Optional

def cancel_pending_order(self, order_id: str, reason: str) -> Any:
    order = self.db.orders.get(order_id)
    if order is None:
        raise ValueError("Order not found")
    if order.status != "pending":
        raise ValueError("Non-pending order cannot be cancelled")
    user = self.db.users.get(order.user_id)
    refunds = []
    for payment in order.payment_history:
        pm_id = payment["payment_method_id"]
        refunds.append({"amount": payment["amount"], "payment_method_id": pm_id,
                        "transaction_type": "refund"})
        pm = (user.payment_methods or {}).get(pm_id) if user else None
        if pm is not None and pm.get("source") == "gift_card":
            pm["balance"] = round(pm["balance"] + payment["amount"], 2)
    order.status = "cancelled"
    order.cancel_reason = reason
    order.payment_history = list(order.payment_history) + refunds
    return order.model_dump()
